Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: CRED's promo card headline rotator - campaign titles cycle automatically inside a dark referral card, each sliding up and crossfading into the next while the illustration and CTA stay put.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark promo card: headline zone at top ("POWER PLAY / ACTIVATE NOW" in purple gradient text alternating with "win assured Rs.400" in serif white), a cash-stack illustration with a circular avatar inset, subcopy, yellow "Refer now" button, and a vouchers footer row.

## Motion spec
Pattern: auto-looping vertical text rotator.
- Each headline holds ~2s, then slides up and fades out (translateY -12px, opacity 1 -> 0, ~300ms, ease-in) while the next rises from below (translateY 12px -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1, same window).
- Gradient headline ("POWER PLAY") keeps its purple gradient fill through the motion; the serif alternate is plain white.
- Illustration avatar inset cycles its own small content (person / coin / star) roughly in sync with headline swaps.
- Everything else on the card is static.

## Calibration
- Slide distance is small (~12px) - this is a ticker, not a page turn.
- The two headline styles (gradient display vs serif) must never be on screen at full opacity simultaneously.

## Reduced motion
Headlines crossfade without travel (250ms).

## Don't miss
- Rotation is automatic and infinite - no user gesture involved.
- Timing is even: every headline gets the same hold duration.
